units.maxFileSizeMiB: MiB per photo or document when answering

hints.maxFileSizeMiB: For each photo or document when answering, from {{min}} to {{max}} MiB; {{max}} MiB is WhatsApp's ceiling. In the app it applies at once; in WhatsApp, each form takes it when it is published again.
hints.dailyRereadsPerAsker: After “Build form with AI”, how many documents of whoever asked are read again a day with the published form, from {{min}} to {{max}}. The rest continue the next day.
hints.similarDocumentsToSuggest: The inbox proposes “Build form with AI” when there are at least this many similar unclassified documents, from {{min}} to {{max}}.
hints.proposedExpiryDays: A document waiting for the team that nobody passed or discarded within this term is discarded as expired. From {{min}} to {{max}} days.
hints.discardedRetentionDays: A discarded or unclassified document is deleted, with its copy and its reading, these days after it was discarded. From {{min}} to {{max}} days.
